messages:
maria: Need quick input on validation UX for billing settings. Two main questions: 1) inline errors on blur vs live validation, 2) destructive confirm pattern for saved payment methods. Thinking: inline helpers on focus, errors on blur for most fields; card number validates live (Luhn). For deleting card, require typed confirm of last4. Thoughts? :thinking: jamal: Live validate card number only, agreed. For other fields blur is fine. But for multi-line addresses we should show an inline invalid count in a sticky header if form >5 fields so users don’t miss errors on long pages. kevin: Typed confirm for payment methods OK, but too much friction for other deletes. Suggest rule: typed confirm for anything that affects billing or PII, simple modal for cosmetic deletes. Also CTA copy should be explicit: "Remove payment method" not just "Delete". sasha: Accessibility checklist: errors must be programmatically linked (aria-describedby) and announced (aria-live=assertive). Required indicator must be both visual and programmatic (aria-required="true"). An asterisk alone is ambiguous for AT users. Also ensure color contrast for any error icons/asterisks. design-bot: WCAG reminder: dialogs must trap focus and have role="dialog" with accessible name. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/ maria: Good points. Jamal can you prototype the sticky invalid-count header? Kevin, we'll scope typed confirm to payment methods + primary billing addresses. Sasha, we'll add ARIA attrs. jamal: Yep will prototype two variants: A) sticky condensed summary showing "2 errors" with jump-to controls, B) top persistent summary only on desktop. Mobile will default to collapsible summary. kevin: Copy for confirm modal proposal: body: "Permanently remove the card ending in 4242. This action cannot be undone." Input placeholder: "Type 4242 to confirm". Primary: "Remove payment method". Secondary: "Cancel". sasha: Modal a11y notes: focus needs to land on the input, ESC should cancel, screen reader must hear error if typed value wrong. Use aria-live in the dialog for inline errors. Also avoid pseudo-elements for "*"; put visible text node so AT can interpret it. maria: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Inline helper text on focus; field errors displayed on blur (except card number validates on input). 2) Form-level summary shown on submit if fields >5 or for mobile condensed view. 3) Required fields show "* (required)" and aria-required="true". 4) Payment-method deletions require typed last4 confirm; dialog meets keyboard + screen-reader flows. jamal: Quick HTML example for the team: ```html
Invalid card number
``` kevin: Looks good. One more UX nit: show subtle success state after correct typed confirm (toast: "Card removed"). Also audit analytics event: confirm_type=typed_last4. sasha: And ensure the typed value is masked in analytics — only capture an event boolean, not the literal digits. maria: Excellent. Let's user-test two flows next week: (1) inline+sticky-summary, (2) inline+submit-summary. QA checklist: keyboard nav, screen reader path, mobile sizing of modal, copy audit. Targeting inclusion in next sprint. Thanks all :raised_hands:
